title: Phone flips from the driving thumb
summary: With Flips on in Extras, phone players now flip with the thumb they drive with: pull it fully back (or left/right) as you hit a ramp and lift to jump into a backflip or 360.
details: This replaces the trick-wheel flips from the previous update; the wheel is back to tricks only.
Lifting on the ramp is still the jump, and now launches the flip at takeoff. Lifting in the first 0.6 s of air also works; later releases never flip, so landings stay safe.
Holding the pull longer before lifting makes a faster flip, up to one second.
The thumb cue turns gold, LIFT → BACKFLIP or LIFT → 360 LEFT/RIGHT, only when lifting will actually flip.
Two-finger mode: hold the left pad fully back or sideways when the right thumb lifts; long right-thumb swipes in the air still work.
Verified with real browser touches on env01: hold to the ramp, the gold cue appears, pull back and lift, and the backflip launches.
limitation: The env01 starting jump is still too short for a full loop.
caption: Holding the throttle into the ramp with the thumb pulled back: the gold cue says lifting now will backflip.
